annotation.title_clean: Inquiry into the use and governance of artificial intelligence systems by public sector entities
annotation.title_en: Inquiry into the use and governance of artificial intelligence systems by public sector entities
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit, Parliament of Australia
annotation.summary_en: Parliament of Australia inquiry landing page for the Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit's inquiry, adopted 12 September 2024, into public sector use and governance of AI systems. It invites submissions by 25 October 2024, lists hearings, and notes concerns that governance frameworks may be inadequate. The report has been tabled.
key_provisions_or_claims: Inquiry adopted 12 September 2024 by the Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit
Examines adoption and use of AI by Commonwealth public sector entities
Evidence suggested governance frameworks may be inadequate to regulate and monitor public sector AI use
Public hearings held in November and December 2024; report tabled
